sources.notes: Testo Unico 12 dicembre 2019 (sha256 18a2f10c...). Art. 53, 57, 64 (apprendistato), Art. 107 (Fon.Te), Artt. 186-187 (malattia), Art. 205 (scatti), Art. 210-211 (quote giornaliera e oraria), Art. 215 (terzo elemento), Artt. 220-221 (tredicesima e quattordicesima), Tabella I (p. 347) vigente dal 01.01.2020.

Ipotesi di accordo 22 marzo 2024 (CNEL 20260, scansione firmata), validità 2023-04-01/2027-03-31. Art. 213 aumenti in 6 tranche (01/04/2023, 01/04/2024, 01/03/2025, 01/11/2025, 01/11/2026, 01/02/2027). Una tantum EUR 350 at level IV, reparametrised for every level, paid 175+175 with the July 2024 and July 2025 pay: not modelled.

Accordo integrativo 28 marzo 2024 (CNEL 20279, scansione firmata): Art. 213 increases with the rounding fixed and the official tabelle retributive 2023-2027 (pp. 2-3), the source of every 2023-2027 base_salary period.

Protocollo straordinario 12 dicembre 2022 (CNEL 19967): acconto EUR 30 at level IV from 1 April 2023 (first 2023-2027 tranche) and una tantum EUR 350 at level IV (January and March 2023), not modelled.

source_document.title: CCNL Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi Confesercenti, Testo Unico 12 dicembre 2019

notes.text: Grade I and the quadri are not apprenticeship destinations: Art. 62 admits the professionalizzante for levels II-VI only.
Track sesto-livello: Art. 53 (last paragraph) sets level VII for the first half of a level VI apprenticeship; the second half is one level below VI, again VII. Level VI from month 25.

Apprenticeship type b (professionalizzante). Durations (Art. 64): II-V 36 months, VI 24 months; half-period 18 and 12 months. The 42 and 48 month profiles of Art. 68 Tabella B are in the unmodelled note.

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: TERZO ELEMENTO NAZIONALE (Art. 215, TU p. 157): EUR 2.07 a month due only in the provinces where no provincial third element is in force (Art. 214); paid when EmployerProfile.provincial_pay_element is false, left out with a missing_fact blocker when it is not stated.

SICKNESS (Art. 187): the CCNL integrates up to a share of the net daily pay ('retribuzione giornaliera netta') without saying how the net pay is computed. The engine grosses up the INPS indemnity by the worker's INPS rate and tops it up to the measure of the gross daily quota, as for the Commercio file. The events exempt from the carenza reduction (hospital stay, day hospital, dialysis, prognosis of 12 days or more, the illnesses of Art. 192, pregnancy) are not inputs: the carenza of such an event is paid at the reduced rate of its order.

limitation.remediation: Model the net daily pay of Art. 187 and the exempt events of its second paragraph.

notes.text: Art. 214: the provincial terzi elementi, amounts set by provincial agreements.

limitation.remediation: Add the provincial terzi elementi as inputs.

notes.text: Art. 218: the indennità di cassa e maneggio denaro of 5%.

limitation.remediation: Model the cashier allowance with a role.

notes.text: The minimi of the operatori di vendita I and II categoria (CNEL 20279 tables).

limitation.remediation: Add the operatori di vendita levels.

notes.text: Art. 211: the hourly divisors 182 and 195 of the 42 and 45 hour weeks.

limitation.remediation: Pick the divisor by the weekly hours.

notes.text: Art. 149: the 30% on Sunday overtime (OT_FESTIVO covers public holidays only).
Art. 54: the apprentice sickness, 60% of the gross pay for the three days of carenza of six events a year and for hospital stays, while the file pays apprentices no integration.

limitation.remediation: Model the apprentice sickness of Art. 54.

notes.text: Art. 68 Tabella B: the 42 and 48 month apprenticeship profiles. The una tantum of the Protocollo 12/12/2022 (EUR 200 + 150 at level IV with the January and March 2023 pay) is historic.

HOURLY RATE AND SUPPLEMENTS (Testo Unico 12 December 2019, unchanged by the 2024 renewal, artt. 149-157, 206-211): without a caller value the engine derives the hourly base (the normale retribuzione of art. 206 over 168), the 15% on ordinary night hours from 22 to 6 (art. 151), the 30% on festività hours paid as straordinario festivo (art. 155 with art. 149), the 30% on ordinary Sunday hours (art. 153; 10% at the motorway fuel stations of art. 157, role impianto_carburante_autostradale: Employment.roles must be stated) and the 30% on the hours of the weekly rest day (art. 156). Art. 155 also pays the festività hours themselves: the engine posts the 30% only and the run is provisional. Second-level agreements may replace the Sunday and night rules (art. 153). Not derived: the divisors 182 and 195 of the 42- and 45-hour weeks; shift work, left to second-level bargaining.

reviews.scope: Every payable rule of the file read again in the signed texts, for the production tier: the Testo Unico of 12 December 2019, the renewal of 22 March 2024, its accordo integrativo of 28 March 2024 and the Protocollo of 12 December 2022.
findings: 86 records verified against the Testo Unico of 12 December 2019 (text layer) and the Accordo integrativo of 28 March 2024 (CNEL 20279, scan read on the page image; quotes are the OCR-verbatim fragments).

Corrected 17 base_salary periods (Q 6, I 4, II 6, VI 1) by 1-5 cents: the file carried the ipotesi increases of 22 March 2024, the accordo integrativo of 28 March 2024 fixed their rounding and printed the official tables.
Sickness: 75% for days 4-20 and 100% from day 21 of the net daily pay, carenza by event, comporto in the calendar year, apprentices excluded (Artt. 186-187), not a flat 75%.

Added the terzo elemento nazionale of EUR 2.07, gated by the provincial element (Art. 215), the payment days of the tredicesima and quattordicesima (Artt. 220-221) and Fon.Te. (Art. 107, 1.55% and 0.55%, apprentices 1.05% by Art. 57).
Overtime premiums are on the normale retribuzione of Art. 206 (hourly_base_method gross_incl_allowances, was minimo_tabellare).
Apprenticeship: the second period closes at 36 months (II-V) and 24 months (VI), as Art. 53 pays the destination level at the end.
The una tantum of 2024-2025 is owed at every level, not only at level IV: limitation lump_sum_2024_2025 rescoped to July 2024 and July 2025.
The source documents had three ids and a tabella_retributiva kind for the same Testo Unico URL: unified. The 22 March 2024 ipotesi and the twin UGL texts (CNEL 20270, 19968) agree with the tables.
No renewal after the accordo integrativo of 28 March 2024 changes pay through October 2026 (CNEL H012 deposits through 20522 of 4 November 2024, training profiles only).
sickness_net_basis is recorded on every run with a sickness event (trigger run), not only documented.
